title: EAC response auctions and archives
EAC响应拍卖及历史档案

source.name: NESO Open Data
source.attribution: Supported by National Energy SO Open Data

notes: CALC-GB-TECH: case-insensitive Battery/Batteries; every other label, NA and blank is other or unlabelled.
Chart-GB-FILL: monthly volume-weighted availability prices; mean cleared MW per EFA block. Pre-EFA daily accepted bids are volume-weighted, represent six blocks and use a separate method.
Historical Delivery Start/End are London wall time, converted to UTC by the source SQL. Masterdata UTC and EAC delivery instants are retained as UTC.
No provider identities, offered-MW line, service maxima sum, requirement series, wholesale price or captured-revenue estimate.
